title: Job Application and CV / Faji kɛ CV
bridge: A taali gi, i tun be se 'ayi la 25 san' anw falan falan, nka denw bamanankan kanbe la, i blanza te 'to have' kɛ falan falan dan ye 'in' anw 'from' anw. O faji 'experience' (sira 'experiences' anw a ka sira koo kelenw ye) kɛ adjektifi ka taa siraba kelen ye. I tun be se 'me dedico a' anw falan falan, nka denw bamanankan kanbe la, i blanza te 'I work as' anw 'I am responsible for'.
rule: A ka faji kɛ a ka taaliw faji bamanankan kan: 1) Dono kanbaya a ka taaliw faji: 'I work as a...' (Ayin ye...), 'I am responsible for...' (Ayin ye...). 2) A ka taaliw faji ka taa, i blanza te 'used to' anw denw ka taa: 'I used to work at...' / 'I worked at...'. 3) 'Have' ka blanza a ka san kɛ a ka taaliw faji: 'I have five years of experience'. 4) Adjektifi taa siraba kelen: 'I have strong communication skills'. 5) 'In' a blanza taaliw faji (experience in hospitality), 'at' a blanza kɛwɛ (at a hotel), kɛ 'as' a blanza taali (as a manager). 6) CV ra, i blanza bulleted points denw ka taa anw dono.

title: Discussing current events / Ka jògidenw ka tuguw fòlòw la
bridge: Espagniyakoy ra, i sôgoma bena a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu, ala wala a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu, kelenkelenkumadenw bena ‘sêgôn’ wala ‘i tun be’ ye. Angalisekoy ra, i sôgoma bena a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘has happened’) ala wala a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘happened’). A fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘is happening’) i sôgoma saba aw ye angalisekoy ra. Kânw ye ka min b’a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘está pasando’) a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘is happening’) sôgoma, sâbabu fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘is happening’) sôgoma aw ye fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (ala wala ‘happens’) sôgoma ye.
rule: Ka tuguw fòlòw la jògidenw angalisekoy ra B1 la: 1. Bugu a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu (have/has + jògidenw) ka tuguw fòlòw la jògidenw bena a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu: ‘Scientists have discovered a new planet.’ 2. Bugu a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu ka tuguw fòlòw la jògidenw bena a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu: ‘They announced the result yesterday.’ 3. Bugu a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu ka tuguw fòlòw la jògidenw bena a fòlòw la tuguw ye a jògidenw kanu: ‘The government is debating the new law.’ 4. Ka tuguw fòlòw la jògidenw, bugu kelenkelenkumadenw bena ‘I think’, ‘In my opinion’, ‘I believe’ jògidenw kanu. 5. Sòròkelenw kôjuman: ‘headline’, ‘article’, ‘report’, ‘according to’, ‘latest’, ‘issue’.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Kulan dɔgɔbaw kanbɔra dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw
bridge: Aspani kan, mɔgɔ sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ la, an ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ la ani i ka jamana ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ la. A fɔlɔ, a fana ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ la, an ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ la ani i ka jamana ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛyaŋw kan dɔw dɔn na kɛlɛyaŋw kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ la. title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Kɔfale yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ
bridge: Sipanilɛn, kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, an ka kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (a ka se ka kɛlɛvɛla) n'a ka kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (an bɛna a ka kɛlɛvɛla). Denw, kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (we pollute) b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ, kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (we are polluting) b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ. Denw, kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (we are going to reduce waste) b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ, an ka kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (reduciremos) b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ. Kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, 'should' b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ, an ka kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana ('deberíamos') b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ.
rule: Kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, B1 tɔgɔ la, an ka kɛlɛvɛla: 1) Kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (hechos generales: 'The planet is warming' – kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana bɛɛminw kɔrɔ; kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana: 'Climate change affects everyone'), 2) Kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana (acciones en progreso: 'Forests are disappearing'), 3) 'be going to' + kɛlɛvɛla (planes futuros: 'We are going to install solar panels'), n'4) 'should' + kɛlɛvɛla (recomendaciones: 'You should recycle more'). Kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, kɛlɛvɛla cogo diɲɛ fana ka kanu bɛɛ ka 'he/she/it' la, a ka kanu bɛɛ ka '-s'. 'There is/are' (hay) kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, 'there is' b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ, 'there are' b'a ka kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ. Kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, an ka kɛlɛvɛla 'because', 'so', 'therefore' bɛɛminw kɔrɔ. Kɛlɛvɛla yeeliw bɛɛminw kɔrɔ la, an ka kɛlɛvɛla adjetivos bɛɛminw kɔrɔ, 'renewable energy', an ka kɛlɛvɛla 'energy renewable' bɛɛminw kɔrɔ.

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Kɔfale ye sɔsyaali media kanw
bridge: Espaɲɛ kan, i sɔrɔ n’a ta araŋ sanakɛyala dumuniŋ ye sanakɛyala ka jamana (tɛmɛntusu ‘aw yaa ye filibɛtɛlɔn’). Amaŋ sɔrɔkɔ, aŋkama sanakɛyala dumuniŋ ye sanakɛyala ka jamana tɛ minw ka taa kɛ. Kɔfale kanw, hispanikanw bɛɛ fɔlɔw’anw ka taa kɛ minw ka taa kɛ ‘m’bɛ click’ an ka taa kɛ ‘m’bɛ foto’ amaŋ sɔrɔkɔ, aŋkama sanakɛyala dumuniŋ ye sanakɛyala ka jamana tɛ minw ka taa kɛ ‘I have to click’ an ka taa kɛ ‘I like the photo’ fana. Kɛlɛya sɔrɔ phrasal verbs (tɛmɛntusu ‘log in’, ‘sign up’) minw ka taa kɛ Espaɲɛ kan.
rule: Kɔfale ye sɔsyaali media kanw B1 tɔgɔ la, fɔlɔw’anw ka taa kɛ: 1) Sanakɛyala dumuniŋ don kɔrɔtanw (I check my phone every morning). 2) Sanakɛyala ka jamana don jamana ka kɔrɔtanw (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Verbs modals don tɔgɔ ye sanakɛyala: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Phrasal verbs ka kaan: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) Kɔfale ye ‘like’ ye ‘share’ (I like the post, She shared the video). Kɛlɛya sɔrɔ ‘social media’ tɛ (I spend time on social media, tɛ ‘in the social media’). Kɔfale kanw, kɔfale ye ‘have’ don kɔfale ye jamankanw (I have a new phone) tɛ ‘tengo’.

title: Talking about Education and Studying Abroad / Kɔfale ye kɔfale kanw ye fɛn bɔ wuli
bridge: Espagnol la, kalilanw kɔfale ye fɛn bɔ wuli kan kɔ, an b'a ka tɛmɛ presentɛ wala futurɛ simpl ('voy a estudiar', 'estudiaré') ka di. Nka, angale kan, an ka tɛmɛ presentɛ kontinu ka di fɛn bɔ wuli kan kɔ ('I am studying') sɛbɛn fɛn bɔ wuli kan ka tɔgɔ la. Muso kɛ, angale kan, an ka tɛ an ka tɔgɔ 'I have 20 years' o, nka 'I am 20 years old'. Kɔfale kan kɔ, an bena ye kɔnɔ ka don an ka tɔgɔw kɔfale ye kɔfale kanw fɛn bɔ wuli kanw ka tɔgɔ la, u si tɛmɛ definini ka tɔgɔ angale kan ('I study mathematics'), nka espagnol kan, an ka tɛmɛ definini ka tɔgɔ ('Estudio las matemáticas'). Kala tɛmɛw yaŋo gɛlɛyaŋo kɔ, ma sira kɛlɛyaŋ bɛɛ.
rule: Angale kan kɔfale ye kɔfale kanw ye fɛn bɔ wuli kan kɔ kɔ B1 tɛmɛ la, tɛmɛ yaŋo di: 1. Presentɛ simplɛ fɛn bɔ wuli ye ka jamana ('I study every day'). 2. Presentɛ kontinu fɛn bɔ wuli ka jamana ('I am studying for my exam') ye fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la ('I am going to England next month'). 3. 'Going to' fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la ('I'm going to apply for a scholarship'). 4. 'Will' fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la wala fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la ('I think it will be a great experience'). 5. Tɛmɛ modaw kɔ 'can', 'must', 'should' fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la, fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la ye fɛn bɔ wuli ka tɔgɔ la ('You should apply early'). 6. Preposisionw: 'study at a university', 'apply for a course', 'major in' (kɔfale kanw fɛn bɔ wuli kan kɔ), 'take an exam'. 7. Kɔfale kanw ye kɔfale kanw fɛn bɔ wuli kanw ka tɔgɔ la tɛmɛ definini ka tɔgɔ ('I like history'). 8. Tɛmɛ 'abroad' (fɛn bɔ wuli) tɛmɛ preposision ka tɔgɔ, nka 'to study abroad' wala 'study abroad' tɛmɛ wala tɛmɛ ka tɔgɔ.

title: Talking about Past Trips and Travel Experiences / Kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la
bridge: Sipanɛɣɛsɛbɛ haɣa, kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, i jaɣa pretérito perfecto ɛɲɛrɛyɛɲuman ye pretérito indefinido, ɛyɛ ɛrɛ la 'he viajado' ɛyɛ 'viajé' ka dumuni ka dumuni kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la. Angalɛɣɛsɛbɛ haɣa, kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, i jaɣa present perfect (have + participio) kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, ɛyɛ ɛrɛ la past simple (viajé) kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la. Kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la ye kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, i jaɣa past simple kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la present perfect kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, ɛyɛ ɛrɛ la '¿Has estado alguna vez...?' kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, sɔrɔla 'have you ever been' kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la. Kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, angalɛɣɛsɛbɛ haɣa, verb irregular bɛɛ, 'go/went/gone' ɛyɛ 'see/saw/seen' kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la, i jaɣa memorización, ɛyɛ ɛrɛ la hispanohablantes bɛɛ, i jaɣa 'been' ɛyɛ 'gone' ka dumuni: 'have been' ka taa 'ir y volver', ɛyɛ 'have gone' ka taa 'está allí ahora'.
rule: Kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la angalɛɣɛsɛbɛ haɣa B1 la, i jaɣa present perfect (have/has + participio pasado) ɛyɛ past simple (verbo en pasado). Present perfect kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la: 1) kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la (I have visited Paris), 2) adverb bɛɛ 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet' (Have you ever been to Japan?), 3) actions that began in the past and continue (I have lived here for three years). Past simple kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la: 1) actions completed in a specific moment in the past (I visited Paris last summer), 2) time expressions bɛɛ 'yesterday', 'in 2019', 'last week', 'when I was a child'. Verbs irregular bɛɛ kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la: go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, eat-ate-eaten, take-took-taken, fly-flew-flown, ride-rode-ridden, drive-drove-driven, stay-stayed-stayed (regular). Question structure present perfect: Have/Has + subject + participio? (Have you ever flown first class?). Short answers: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Past simple: Did + subject + verbo base? (Did you go to the beach?). Short answers: Yes, I did / No, I didn't. 'Ever' ɛyɛ 'never' ka taa present perfect, past simple yɛrɛ: 'I have never been to Mexico' (yɛrɛ 'I never went to Mexico' kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la). 'Since' yɛrɛ ka taa point final in the past (I have visited Spain since 2018 - yɛrɛ kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la), 'since' ka taa action start (I have been in Spain since 2018). Adjective opinion bɛɛ (amazing, terrible, wonderful, boring) ka taa 'was/were' past simple la kɛlɛya kɔnɔniye dɔw dɔw la.

title: Talking about habits and routines / Faranw bɛεw kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la
bridge: Espagnol kan, an b’a tɛ faranw bɛεw kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, an ma taga ka k’a sira kan kɛ fana fani dɔw la, nka, fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw b’a la. Angalɛ kan, faranw bɛεw kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, a b’a tɛ se ka ‘do/does’ k’a fa fani dɔw la, nka, espagnol kan, an ma taga ka ‘no’ an ka taga ka fani dɔw la. Fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw b’a la, a b’a tɛ se ka fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw b’a kɔnɔ ‘to be’ k’a fa fani dɔw la, nka, espagnol kan, an ma taga ka fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw b’a la. Kɛlɛya, o fɔri k’a fa fani dɔw la, o b’a tɛ se ka ‘s’ k’a fa fani dɔw la (he/she/it), nka, espagnol kan, an ma taga ka fani dɔw la.
rule: Angalɛ kan, faranw bɛεw kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, a b’a tɛ se ka present simple k’a fa fani dɔw la. Fani kɛlɛya (he, she, it), a b’a tɛ se ka -s an ka -es k’a fa fani dɔw la (e.g., 'works', 'goes'). Fani dɔw la, a b’a tɛ se ka ‘do not’ (don't) an ka ‘does not’ (doesn't) + fani kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la. Fani kɛlɛya, a b’a tɛ se ka ‘do’ an ka ‘does’ k’a fa fani dɔw la, o kɔ, fani kɛlɛya an ka fani kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la. Fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) b’a tɛ se ka: (1) fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw k’a fa fani dɔw la (I always drink coffee), (2) fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw k’a fa fani dɔw la ‘to be’ k’a fa fani dɔw la (He is always late), an (3) fɔlɔw fana kɛ fana fɔlɔw k’a fa fani dɔw la an ka fani kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la (Do you often exercise?). Ala ko: ‘have’ fana kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, a b’a tɛ se ka ‘have/has’ (I have breakfast at 8). ‘Go’ an ka ‘do’ fana kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, fani kɛlɛya b’a tɛ se ka ‘goes’ an ka ‘does’. Fani jamana kɔnɔ k’a fa fani dɔw la, o b’a tɛ se ka present simple k’a fa fani dɔw la; o b’a tɛ se ka present continuous k’a fa fani dɔw la.
